thread:
maria_csops: Quick sync — proposing a narrow 'contact amnesty' pilot to surface and reconcile stale duplicate contacts in CRM, then run a healthscore backfill and a soft enablement nudge. Primary goals: reduce false renewal-risk alerts, improve owner visibility, and capture enablement feedback. Who wants to own sampling and dry-run?
liam_data: +1. I can own the sampling logic. Suggest sample=5% of accounts that meet: >2 email aliases OR duplicate contact_ids, last_active >= 180d, and healthscore between 35-60. That avoids the very healthy/high-touch accounts. :thinking_face:
anya_platform: We can run this through the admin playbook runner. Prefer a two-step flow: dry-run (no writes) -> owner review -> commit. Also we should emit a webhook to the staging enablement form for feedback.
rahul_eng: We should use the playbook-runner v2 flags for idempotency. Proposed sequence:
```yaml
playbook: contact-amnesty-pilot
sample_pct: 5
dry_run: true
actions:
  - tag: amnesty_candidate
  - flag_healthscore_recalc: true
  - notify_owner: false
```
After dry-run and QA we flip dry_run=false and enable notify_owner.
jen_customer: Important — when we notify owners, include a one-click 'claim' and a tiny survey so we capture why they kept/merged contacts (enablement feedback). Use short form: 3 options + free text. Put link to form in message.
liam_data: For metrics, I'll compute: pre/post healthscore distribution, number of renewal-risk flips, and owner claim rate. Need a tagging schema: amnesty:v1 plus sample_id. Also track via telemetry event `amnesty.scan` and `amnesty.commit`.
anya_platform: I'll schedule the dry-run job in staging and attach the webhook. Can you provide the sample query, liam?
liam_data: Putting the query here (rough):
```sql
SELECT account_id, contact_id, ARRAY_LENGTH(emails) as alias_count, last_active_at, healthscore
FROM crm.contacts
WHERE (ARRAY_LENGTH(emails) > 2 OR duplicate_group_id IS NOT NULL)
  AND last_active_at < now() - interval '180 days'
  AND healthscore BETWEEN 35 AND 60
ORDER BY random()
LIMIT (SELECT CAST(count(*) * 0.05 AS integer) FROM crm.contacts WHERE /* same filter */);
```
rahul_eng: For safety, enforce a write-quota and a soft throttle (e.g., 100 commits/hour) and require a manual 'go' from CS Ops lead to flip commit flag. I can add that guard into the runner.
opsbot: automated-check: legal-consent-required=false for staging run; production runs will block until legal approval.
jen_customer: I'll craft the 3-option survey and put an enablement template message for owners. Also want a short KB doc for owners describing expected steps.
maria_csops: Great — plan of record: 1) liam to provide final sample query and telemetry fields; 2) anya to schedule staging dry-run + webhook; 3) rahul to add commit throttle & idempotency guard; 4) jen to prepare owner message + survey + KB. I'll loop in legal and data-privacy for sign-off. Target: dry-run this Friday (one-week runway) and review results next Tuesday. Tagging owners: @liam_data @anya_platform @rahul_eng @jen_customer. :thumbsup:
liam_data: Ack — will drop query PR by EOD and include a snapshot of sample.
anya_platform: Scheduling now, will post run-id when created.
jen_customer: Drafting owner message and survey, will share for review.
maria_csops: Thanks all — if no blockers I'll open the run playbook tomorrow morning and post the final run plan here. :rocket:
